summary: Implemented the file-reading progress feature. rich/progress.py: private _ProgressReader (RawIOBase subclass) and _ReaderContext, module-level open and wrap_file after track(), and Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file after Progress.track. Also added a private _make_progress helper for building the display. tests/test_progress.py: 14 new tests. docs/source/progress.rst: two new sections. CHANGELOG.md: one Unreleased/Added entry without a PR link. Nothing was run and nothing was committed, per instructions, so verification was by reading only. Open points: a getsize failure surfaces as ValueError; a failed open with explicit total can leave a task behind; the seek parameter is named offset per spec, which may trigger a type-checker override warning; binary mode ignores encoding, errors and newline.
